story.title:
From a Seoul alley
to your Dracut table.
story.body1: The warmth of the tteokbokki shop outside the school gate — that's the feeling we wanted to bring to Dracut. Hand-rolled kimbap, fresh-stirred rice cakes, and bubble tea brewed to order.
story.body2: A new discovery for our American neighbors, a familiar comfort for Korean families — that's why our promise is simple.
